correctness.rationale: A missing composition type gives exactly one output; different lengths cannot coincide. The mirrored prefix/suffix equalities reduce to returns of a full-rank aperiodic q-ary difference walk. Renewal equations prove both parity-specific pgfs. The explicit lattice covariance and local CLT yield return asymptotics, and factorial moments/renewal transience give the half-normal, exponential, and geometric limits. Complete finite word enumeration and rational return convolution independently agreed for 84133 inputs; this is corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: The number of distinguishable missing mass/composition measurements is a natural channel sphere statistic. The result gives a complete distribution for all n and q and identifies a sharp transition from sqrt(n) half-normal deficit to log(n) exponential to tight geometric behavior. It quantifies information ambiguity beyond an arbitrary finite census and is relevant to choosing the alphabet in mass-spectrum observation models; no unproved optimal-code conclusion is asserted.
